notes.note: Focused review of the desktop Inbox toggle in the composer, placement and responsive guides, pane ownership and Personal Board routing, portable/device settings, API boundaries, and the Inbox journeys in Concepts and Getting Started. The desktop caller reuses the resolved lazy component type at the same conditional mount. Its controls, full detach, exit transition, focus handling, row actions, scope and device settings still use their documented owners. The local production Chromium witness exercised cold and warm opens, search and scroll reset, active conversation and draft retention, focus, quick reversal, reduced motion, and transient loader recovery. The extended dock-mode test change asserts the timing of the existing toggle and landmark and introduces no public interface. Physical-device and hosted behavior were outside this review.
